prompt: Create a high-resolution clean-alpha item illustration for the original Cosyworld card game. One folded heavy blue-black linen and wool cloth lying in loose broad folds, with a coarse hand-woven texture, two ragged knotted fringed edges and an occasional fine amber thread. Preserve the color and identity of the attached Cosyworld reference: deep blue-black shadow with warm amber rim light, painterly, worn and soft heavy folds rather than smooth fabric. An uncanny storybook painting in 3/4 view, richly hand-painted detail, restrained highlights, readable at a tiny card size. Silhouette should fit with clear margin on each side, filling about 80% of a square canvas. Only the cloth, centered on true fully transparent alpha, no ground, no cast shadow, no other objects, no text, no border.

assets.processing: Resized to 1050 pixels square and centered on a transparent 1254-pixel canvas to give the fringe room.
Flattened the new cutout onto a dark blue-gray background for the existing JPEG URL.
